title: Three Pieces Are Enough
setup: You are down a queen, two rooks and a bishop, and three white pieces stand around the black king on d8.
hint: Material tells you nothing here. Count the black king's squares and find who already covers them.
explanation:
## The Idea

The knight on d5 covers c7 and e7, the knight on g7 covers e8, and Black's own bishop and pawn block c8 and d7. {{Be7#}} steps into the last gap, defended by the knight, and Black is mated with a queen, two rooks and a bishop extra.
